slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether exactly one protein source must be selected or whether multiple proteins can be combined; it silently allowed any non-negative amount of all foods.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum number of vegetable types; it treated all foods as freely selectable with no vegetable variety constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Any combination of protein sources is allowed, with no requirement to select exactly one protein.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the protein selection rule and then modeled all foods as freely selectable non-negative amounts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum number of vegetable types required.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about vegetable variety and then modeled all foods as freely selectable non-negative amounts.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P1 hidden slots, protein selection rule and minimum vegetable types, remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful details about weight scope, fractional amounts, budget hardness, meat fiber, and tie-breaking, but missed both P1 hidden constraints on protein selection and vegetable variety, then stopped prematurely with an incomplete model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
